newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia rupiah steady amid liquidity, rate cut.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia rupiah steady amid liquidity, rate cut.

text.p: The Indonesian rupiah was steady against the dollar in thin late trading on Wednesday amid sustained flush liquidity and the central bank's fixing rate cut, dealers said.
Spot rupiah was quoted at 2,405.25/05.75 at 0910 GMT compared with an opening of 2,405.30/05.80.
Dealers said volume was relatively thin as sentiment on the local currency improved due to tighter liquidity outlook ahead of the fiscal year-end on March 31.
